code: STs <- list()  if (run_visium) {   sample_dirs <- visium_sample_dirs(visium_cfg$ds_root)    build_sample <- function(d) {     st <- STlist(d, samples = basename(d), cores = 1)     st <- filter_data(st, spot_minreads = 500, spot_mingenes = 300)     transform_data(st, method = "log", cores = 1)   }   per_sample <- lapply(sample_dirs, function(d)     tryCatch(build_sample(d), error = function(e) NULL))   names(per_sample) <- basename(sample_dirs)    st_v <- merge_stlists(per_sample)   STs$visium <- list(st = st_v, smp1 = names(st_v@spatial_meta)[1],                      out_dir = visium_cfg$out_dir,                      label = paste0("Visium (", length(st_v@spatial_meta), " samples)"),                      fov = NA_character_, mode = visium_cfg$mode) } if (run_cosmx) {   prep   <- load_cosmx(cosmx_cfg$inputs, params$cosmx_celltype_col)   io_map    <- prep$io_map      # FOV -> IO status   celltypes <- prep$celltypes   # per-cell type labels, used for abundance later    requested <- if (identical(tolower(as.character(params$cosmx_fov)), "all")) {     prep$design %>%       filter(FOV_majority == "Tumor", !is.na(IO)) %>%       transmute(fov_name = paste0(Slide_name, "_fov", fov)) %>%       pull(fov_name)   } else trimws(strsplit(as.character(params$cosmx_fov), ",")[[1]])   requested <- unique(requested[!is.na(requested) & nzchar(requested)])    st_per_fov <- setNames(lapply(requested, build_cosmx_fov, prep = prep), requested)   st_multi   <- merge_stlists(st_per_fov)    STs$cosmx <- list(st = st_multi, smp1 = names(st_multi@spatial_meta)[1],                     out_dir = cosmx_cfg$out_dir,                     label = paste0("CosMx (", length(st_multi@spatial_meta), " FOVs)"),                     fov = requested)   rm(prep); invisible(gc()) }
